title: ShareNotification/query args
description: Arguments for ShareNotification/query (RFC 9670 §4.4). Returns an ordered list of ShareNotification ids.

accountId.description: The account to query share notifications from.

sort.description: Sort criteria. Each Comparator has a property (e.g. created) and optional isAscending (default true).

position.description: 0-based index of the first result to return.

anchor.description: A ShareNotificationId to anchor the result page at.

anchorOffset.description: Offset from the anchor (may be negative).

limit.description: Maximum number of ids to return.

calculateTotal.description: If true, return the total number of share notifications.
